items.title: Hundreds protest against Australia's largest defence expo in Perth

children.content: Protesters in Perth gather to oppose the biennial Land Forces expo, held in Perth two years after ugly scenes in Melbourne.

items.title: ASX rises for third straight day, Nasdaq hits new record high — as it happened
